title: New Session
summary: The conversation began with a casual greeting between Shibam and Addy, quickly shifting to a discussion about browser automation when Shibam asked about the Playwright browser and mentioned a menu and a baby hotel. During this interaction, Addy attempted to use desktop agent tools to open and manage browser tabs, but repeatedly encountered technical failures and timeouts. Shibam questioned why a blank page was being opened and checked if Addy could still hear him amidst the errors. The session concluded with Addy apologizing and acknowledging that the desktop agent was experiencing technical difficulties. Consequently, the browser tasks and the initial queries regarding the web content remained unfinished, which should be addressed once the desktop agent issues are resolved in the next session.
